exposure: white matter injury assessment at early brain MRI (30-34 weeks' postmenstrual age)
global injury severity at early brain MRI
outcome: white matter injury assessment at term-equivalent MRI (37-42 weeks)
global injury severity at term-equivalent MRI
cohort: The study included 30 preterm infants born at less than 33 weeks' gestational age.
finding: There was a strong association between the systematic assessments of white matter injury at early (30-34 weeks) and term-equivalent (37-42 weeks) time points, as well as their global injury severity.
followup_time: From 30-34 weeks' postmenstrual age to 37-42 weeks' postmenstrual age (approximately 7-12 weeks)
